answer_draft:
**What is happening**
Turkana is at drought Warning level [T1], with 3-month rainfall at 35.0% [T1] of normal (21.0 mm [T1] vs 60.7 mm [T1] normal) to 2026-10 [T1]. Observed 3-day max rainfall reached 6.3 mm [T1].

**What is likely next**
We cannot say exactly when or where rain will fall at a farm or village [T2]. From 2026-11-12 [T2] to 2026-11-18 [T2], total forecast rainfall is 42.3 mm [T2] with a max 3-day total of 34.8 mm [T2] (12 Nov - 14 Nov [T2]), placing heavy rain at Watch level [T2]. For Nov 2026 - Jan 2027 [T3], the probability of below-normal rain is 33% [T3] with low confidence [T3].

**Who is exposed**
Turkana has a population of 1226408 [T4], with 1226408 [T5] people at Watch level or above [T5], holding priority rank 2 [T5].

**What to prepare**
Drought (Warning):
- DR-A1 [T6]: Repair and rehabilitate water facilities
- DR-A2 [T6]: Desilt water pans and repair earth dams
- DR-A3 [T6]: Install mass water storage tanks
- DR-A4 [T6]: Provide cash for WASH
- DR-A5 [T6]: Provide fodder for priority livestock
- DR-A6 [T6]: Distribute drought-tolerant seeds
- DR-A7 [T6]: Encourage early de-stocking

Flood (Watch):
- FL-W1 [T7]: Disseminate early warnings
- FL-W2 [T7]: Place flood depth markers
- FL-W3 [T7]: Identify evacuation sites
- FL-W4 [T7]: Pre-position relief items
- FL-W5 [T7]: Advise storing valuables above flood level
